description: The 14 parishes of Jamaica as polygons from OCHA COD-AB Jamaica v01 admin level 1 (source: Jamaica Social Development Commission; boundaries created 2017-09-09, valid for humanitarian use from 2024-08-02), with the COD-PS Jamaica 2011 census columns (source: Statistical Institute of Jamaica) joined on parish name: T_TL, F_TL, M_TL totals and T_/F_/M_ five-year age bands 00_04 to 60_64 and 65Plus. All 14 parishes join (measured). adm1_pcode is the COD-AB code (JM01-JM14); ps_adm1_pcode keeps the COD-PS code, which differs for 12 parishes. Parish names are spelled Saint Andrew, Saint Ann, ... (never St.). Kingston and Saint Andrew are two separate units. Sum of T_TL = 2,697,983 (2011 census). Retrieved from HDX on 2026-09-23 via the CKAN API (package_show cod-ab-jam, cod-ps-jam).
